{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

arm_counts = df['arm'].value_counts()

severity_counts = df['severity'].value_counts()

# Return all
print(missing_values)
print(duplicates)
print(sex_counts)
